description: MCP interface for the Serverless topology. Provides tools for inspecting and validating serverless function configurations, resources for manifest and ruleset access, and prompts for serverless-readiness and implementation guidance.

tools.name: evolith-topology-inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Serverless topology configuration and return its parsed manifest, function definitions, and corpus artifact references.

configPath.description: Path to the Serverless configuration file

tools.name: evolith-topology-validate
tools.description: Validate a Serverless configuration against the topology ruleset and OPA policies, returning pass/fail per gate.

configPath.description: Path to the Serverless configuration to validate

strictMode.description: Fail on warnings, not just errors

resources.name: Serverless Topology Manifest
resources.description: Full topology manifest for Serverless, including metadata, artifact references, and corpus configuration.

resources.name: Serverless Rulesets
resources.description: All ruleset files for Serverless: native rules JSON, OPA Rego policies, and WASM bundle.

prompts.name: serverless-readiness-review
prompts.description: Assesses whether a workload is suitable for serverless deployment, evaluating cold-start tolerance, statelessness, timeout limits, and cost profile.

prompts.name: topology-aware-implementation
prompts.description: Guides AI-assisted implementation to respect Serverless topology constraints, ephemeral stateless design, and event-driven triggers.
